# Note: subset data, then recreate quartile variable
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## R Markdown

```{r DMP subset: exclude individuals who died within the first 24 months}

analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag<-subset(analysis_URXOP1_crt, !(mortstat==1 & permth_exm<=24))

dim(analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag)
```

```{r DMP dataset: create CVD death and cancer death variables}
#death due to CVD vs all other people; create CVD_death variable
analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables  <- analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables %>%
  mutate(CVD_death = case_when(
    ucod_leading==1~1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  ))

table(analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables$CVD_death, useNA = "always")

CVD_dead_by_quartile <- analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables %>%  
  group_by(quartile) %>%                     # Group by quartile
  summarise(
    deaths = sum(CVD_death == 1),  # Count deaths where mortstat == 1
    total  = n() # Count total rows
  )

CVD_dead_by_quartile

#death due to cancer vs all other people; create cancer_death variable
analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables  <- analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables %>%
  mutate(cancer_death = case_when(
    ucod_leading==2~1,
    TRUE ~ 0
  ))


cancer_dead_by_quartile <- analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables %>%  
  group_by(quartile) %>%                     # Group by quartile
  summarise(
    deaths = sum(cancer_death == 1),  # Count deaths where mortstat == 1
    total  = n() # Count total rows
  )

cancer_dead_by_quartile

#analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables |> count(mortstat, CVD_death)
#analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables |> count(mortstat, cancer_death)
```


```{r DMP dataset: create quartile variable for subgroup (individuals who DID NOT die within the first 24 months)}
#create creatinine adjusted exposure (O'Brien's method)
# take the log of creatinine variable
analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables<- analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables %>% 
  mutate(logC = log(URXUCR))

# Fit the regression model
#check percent missing on bmicat: about 1%, has missing category
summary(analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables$bmicat)
model <- lm(logC ~ RIDAGEYR+ sex+race+bmicat+SDDSRVYR, data = analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables)

# Add predicted values variable to the dataset
analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables$plogC <- predict(model, data = analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables)

# Compute new variables
analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables <- analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables %>%
  mutate(
    pC = exp(plogC),
    Cratio = URXUCR / pC,
    URXOP1_crt = URXOP1 / Cratio
  )

# View the updated dataset
head(analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables %>% select(SEQN, URXOP1_crt))


max(analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables$URXOP1_crt)
# analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables %>% 
#   group_by(SDDSRVYR) %>% 
#   summarize(max_URXOP1_crt = max(URXOP1_crt, na.rm = TRUE))

#create the cycle-specific quartiles
analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables <- analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables %>%
  group_by(SDDSRVYR) %>%
  mutate(
    quartile = as.numeric(
      cut(
        URXOP1_crt,
        breaks = quantile(URXOP1_crt, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25), na.rm = TRUE),
        include.lowest = TRUE,
        labels = FALSE
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

table(analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables$quartile)

quartile_check <- analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag$variables %>%
  group_by(SDDSRVYR, quartile) %>%  # Group by cycle & quartile
  summarise(
    count = n(), 
    min_URXOP1_crt = min(URXOP1_crt, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_URXOP1_crt = max(URXOP1_crt, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(SDDSRVYR) %>%                                # Regroup to calculate percentages
  mutate(percentage = round(100 * count / sum(count), 2)) %>%  # Calculate % within each cycle
  arrange(SDDSRVYR,quartile)   # Sort for easier comparison

quartile_check
```

```{r DMP, all-cause modeling}
# Q2, Q3, Q4 hazard ratios
all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_death_lag=svycoxph(
  formula = Surv(permth_exm, mortstat) ~ as.factor(quartile)+ RIDAGEYR+sex+URXUCR + race+edu+pir+mvp_label+bmicat+smk_label+SDDSRVYR+alcg_label,  
  design = analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag
) |> tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE)

#p-trend
all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_pval_death_lag=svycoxph(
  formula = Surv(permth_exm, mortstat) ~ quartile+ RIDAGEYR+sex+URXUCR + race+edu+pir+mvp_label+bmicat+smk_label+SDDSRVYR+alcg_label,  
  design = analysis_URXOP1_crt.death.lag
) |> tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE)


```

```{r  DMP, all-cause modeling extract estimates into table}
all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_death_lag_p_trend_numbers=all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_pval_death_lag$table_body %>% filter(term=="quartile") %>% select(p.value)
all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_death_lag_p_trend_numbers

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_death_lag_numbers=all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_death_lag$table_body %>% filter(term=="as.factor(quartile)2"|term=="as.factor(quartile)3"|term=="as.factor(quartile)4") %>% 
  select(term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high) %>% 
  mutate(
    Metabolite="DMP",
    Outcome="All cause",
    HR=round(estimate, digits=2),
         CI_low=round(conf.low, digits=2),
         CI_high=round(conf.high, digits=2),
    HR_CI=paste0(HR, " (", CI_low, ", ", CI_high, ")")) %>% 
  select(Metabolite, Outcome, term, HR_CI)

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_death_lag_numbers

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_death_lag_final=bind_cols( all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_death_lag_numbers, all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_death_lag_p_trend_numbers)
all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_death_lag_final

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_death_lag_final_wide=all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_death_lag_final %>% pivot_wider(names_from=term, values_from=HR_CI) %>% select(Outcome, Metabolite, `as.factor(quartile)2`,`as.factor(quartile)3`,`as.factor(quartile)4`, p.value)
all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_adj_death_lag_final_wide
```

```{r DETP dataset: create quartile variable for subgroup (individuals who DID NOT die within the first 24 months)}
#create creatinine adjusted exposure (O'Brien's method)
# take the log of creatinine variable
analysis_URXOP4_crt.death.lag$variables<- analysis_URXOP4_crt.death.lag$variables %>% 
  mutate(logC = log(URXUCR))

# Fit the regression model
#check percent missing on bmicat: about 1%, has missing category
summary(analysis_URXOP4_crt.death.lag$variables$bmicat)
model <- lm(logC ~ RIDAGEYR+ sex+race+bmicat+SDDSRVYR, data = analysis_URXOP4_crt.death.lag$variables)

# Add predicted values variable to the dataset
analysis_URXOP4_crt.death.lag$variables$plogC <- predict(model, data = analysis_URXOP4_crt.death.lag$variables)

# Compute new variables
analysis_URXOP4_crt.death.lag$variables <- analysis_URXOP4_crt.death.lag$variables %>%
  mutate(
    pC = exp(plogC),
    Cratio = URXUCR / pC,
    URXOP4_crt = URXOP4 / Cratio
  )

# View the updated dataset
head(analysis_URXOP4_crt.death.lag$variables %>% select(SEQN, URXOP4_crt))


max(analysis_URXOP4_crt.death.lag$variables$URXOP4_crt)
# analysis_URXOP4_crt.death.lag$variables %>% 
#   group_by(SDDSRVYR) %>% 
#   summarize(max_URXOP4_crt = max(URXOP4_crt, na.rm = TRUE))

#create the cycle-specific quartiles
analysis_URXOP4_crt.death.lag$variables <- analysis_URXOP4_crt.death.lag$variables %>%
  group_by(SDDSRVYR) %>%
  mutate(
    quartile = as.numeric(
      cut(
        URXOP4_crt,
        breaks = quantile(URXOP4_crt, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25), na.rm = TRUE),
        include.lowest = TRUE,
        labels = FALSE
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

table(analysis_URXOP4_crt.death.lag$variables$quartile)

quartile_check <- analysis_URXOP4_crt.death.lag$variables %>%
  group_by(SDDSRVYR, quartile) %>%  # Group by cycle & quartile
  summarise(
    count = n(), 
    min_URXOP4_crt = min(URXOP4_crt, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_URXOP4_crt = max(URXOP4_crt, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(SDDSRVYR) %>%                                # Regroup to calculate percentages
  mutate(percentage = round(100 * count / sum(count), 2)) %>%  # Calculate % within each cycle
  arrange(SDDSRVYR,quartile)   # Sort for easier comparison

quartile_check
```
